daylight_overshadowing.guidance_source: Daylight and Sunlight SPG + BRE 209 methodology
daylight_overshadowing.notes: Podium massing directly opposite Canal Walk Residences is the primary daylight risk. No detailed VSC/APSH technical model has been run yet at this stage; findings are based on massing sketches and general guidance only.

contamination.history: Former light-industrial use on part of the site (pre-1980s). Phase 1 desk study recommended; no Phase 2 intrusive investigation completed yet.

noise.notes: Site fronts a moderately trafficked road; residential units above podium level likely need enhanced glazing specification.

wind_microclimate.notes: No pedestrian wind microclimate study completed yet; podium height and massing may affect ground-level comfort at the public realm entrance.
